text_en: Now when the people complained in the hearing of the Lord about their misfortunes, the Lord heard it and his anger was kindled. Then the fire of the Lord burned against them, and consumed some outlying parts of the camp.
text_cn: 当时人民怨声载道，怨声已传入上主的耳中；上主听见，遂发怒；上主的火在他们中燃起，焚烧了营幕的边缘。

text_en: But the people cried out to Moses; and Moses prayed to the Lord , and the fire abated.
text_cn: 人民遂向梅瑟求救；梅瑟恳求了上主，火就熄灭了，

text_en: So that place was called Taberah, because the fire of the Lord burned against them.
text_cn: 遂给那地方起名叫塔贝辣，因为上主的火曾在他们中燃烧起来。

text_en: The rabble among them had a strong craving; and the Israelites also wept again, and said, “If only we had meat to eat!
text_cn: 那些跟百姓来的杂族人甚是贪求口腹， 连以色列子民也开始哭泣说：“谁给我们肉吃？

text_en: We remember the fish we used to eat in Egypt for nothing, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic;
text_cn: 我们记得：在埃及我们可随便吃鱼，还有胡瓜、西瓜、韮菜、葱和蒜。

text_en: but now our strength is dried up, and there is nothing at all but this manna to look at. ”
text_cn: 现在我们的心灵憔悴，我们眼见的除‘玛纳’外，什么也没有。”

text_en: Now the manna was like coriander seed, and its color was like the color of gum resin.
text_cn: “玛纳”形似胡荽（suī）种子，色彩有如珍珠。

text_en: The people went around and gathered it, ground it in mills or beat it in mortars, then boiled it in pots and made cakes of it; and the taste of it was like the taste of cakes baked with oil.
text_cn: 人民四散收敛，用磨研细，或在臼（jiù）内捣碎，在锅内煮了做成饼，它的滋味有如油饼的滋味。

text_en: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna would fall with it.
text_cn: 夜间露水降在营上时，也降下“玛纳”。

text_en: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, all at the entrances of their tents. Then the Lord became very angry, and Moses was displeased.
text_cn: 梅瑟听见百姓家家户户，各在帐棚门口悲哭。上主大发忿怒，梅瑟见了也很难受，

text_en: So Moses said to the Lord , “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why have I not found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
text_cn: 遂对上主说：“你为什么难为你的仆人？为什么我在你眼中不蒙宠幸，竟将管理这百姓的担子全放在我身上？

text_en: Did I conceive all this people? Did I give birth to them, that you should say to me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a sucking child, to the land that you promised on oath to their ancestors’?
text_cn: 莫非是我怀孕了这百姓，或是我生了他们，你竟对我说：你要怀抱他们，如同褓母怀抱乳儿，直到进入你对他们的祖先所誓许的地方？

text_en: Where am I to get meat to give to all this people? For they come weeping to me and say, ‘Give us meat to eat! ’
text_cn: 我从哪里拿肉给这百姓吃？因为他们向我哭诉说：给我们肉吃！

text_en: I am not able to carry all this people alone, for they are too heavy for me.
text_cn: 我独自不能抱着这百姓，这为我太重。

text_en: If this is the way you are going to treat me, put me to death at once—if I have found favor in your sight—and do not let me see my misery. ”
text_cn: 若你愿这样对待我，如果我在你眼中得宠，求你杀了我吧！免得我受这苦楚。”

text_en: So the Lord said to Moses, “Gather for me seventy of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; bring them to the tent of meeting, and have them take their place there with you.
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“你给我由以色列老年人中召选七十人，你知道他们是民间的老前辈和会办事的人，领他们进入会幕，叫他们同你一起站在那里。

text_en: I will come down and talk with you there; and I will take some of the spirit that is on you and put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people along with you so that you will not bear it all by yourself.
text_cn: 在那里我要降下，与你交谈，取些你身上具有的神能，赋给他们，叫他们与你分担管理人民的重担，不让你个人独自承担。

text_en: And say to the people: Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat meat; for you have wailed in the hearing of the Lord , saying, ‘If only we had meat to eat! Surely it was better for us in Egypt. ’ Therefore the Lord will give you meat, and you shall eat.
text_cn: 你对民众说：你们圣洁自己直到明天，你们就会有肉吃，因为上主已听见你们哀哭说：谁给我们肉吃？我们在埃及是多么好！如今上主要给你们肉吃了；

text_en: You shall eat not only one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,
text_cn: 不但是一天、两天、五天、十天、二十天，你们有肉吃，

text_en: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and becomes loathsome to you—because you have rejected the Lord who is among you, and have wailed before him, saying, ‘Why did we ever leave Egypt? ’”
text_cn: 而是整月，直到肉从你们的鼻子里出来，吃的生厌，因为你们轻视了住在你们中的上主，在他面前涕泣说：为什么我们出离了埃及？”

text_en: But Moses said, “The people I am with number six hundred thousand on foot; and you say, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat for a whole month’!
text_cn: 梅瑟说：“与我同住的人民，步行的男子就有六十万，你却说：我要给他们肉吃，且吃一整月。

text_en: Are there enough flocks and herds to slaughter for them? Are there enough fish in the sea to catch for them? ”
text_cn: 就是将牛羊都为他们杀了，为他们够用么？或将海里的鱼全给他们捉来，为他们足用么？”

text_en: The Lord said to Moses, “Is the Lord ’s power limited? Now you shall see whether my word will come true for you or not. ”
text_cn: 上主回答梅瑟说：“难道上主的手短了？你就要看见我对你说的话是否应验。”

text_en: So Moses went out and told the people the words of the Lord ; and he gathered seventy elders of the people, and placed them all around the tent.
text_cn: 梅瑟将上主的话告诉了人民；随后从人民的老年人中召选了七十人，令他们站在会幕四周。

text_en: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and took some of the spirit that was on him and put it on the seventy elders; and when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied. But they did not do so again.
text_cn: 上主乘云降下，与梅瑟谈话；将他身上的神能，赋给那七十位长老；这神能一降在他们身上，他们就出神说话；以后再没有出神。

text_en: Two men remained in the camp, one named Eldad, and the other named Medad, and the spirit rested on them; they were among those registered, but they had not gone out to the tent, and so they prophesied in the camp.
text_cn: 当时有两个人留在营内，一个名叫厄耳达得，一个名叫默达得；这神能也降在他们身上；他们原是在被录取的人内，却没有到会幕那里去，就在营内出神说话。

text_en: And a young man ran and told Moses, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp. ”
text_cn: 有一少年跑来告诉梅瑟说：“厄耳达得和默达得在营内出神说话。”

text_en: And Joshua son of Nun, the assistant of Moses, one of his chosen men, said, “My lord Moses, stop them! ”
text_cn: 自幼即服事梅瑟的农的儿子若苏厄遂说：“我主梅瑟！你该禁止他们。”

text_en: But Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? Would that all the Lord ’s people were prophets, and that the Lord would put his spirit on them! ”
text_cn: 梅瑟回答他说：“你为我的缘故嫉妒人么？巴不得上主的人民都成先知，上主将自己的精神贯注在他们身上！”

text_en: And Moses and the elders of Israel returned to the camp.
text_cn: 梅瑟遂与以色列的长老回到了营内。

text_en: Then a wind went out from the Lord , and it brought quails from the sea and let them fall beside the camp, about a day’s journey on this side and a day’s journey on the other side, all around the camp, about two cubits deep on the ground.
text_cn: 那时上主使一阵风刮起，由海上吹来了鹌鹑，散落在营幕上；鹌鹑在营幕四周多得有一天路程那么远，在地面上约有二肘厚。

text_en: So the people worked all that day and night and all the next day, gathering the quails; the least anyone gathered was ten homers; and they spread them out for themselves all around the camp.
text_cn: 人民那一整日整夜，且在第二日整天都忙于捕捉鹌鹑，收集得最少的，也收集了十堆，都摆在营幕四周。

text_en: But while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was consumed, the anger of the Lord was kindled against the people, and the Lord struck the people with a very great plague.
text_cn: 肉还在他们的牙齿间，尚未嚼烂，上主就对人民发怒了，以极严重的灾祸打击了人民。

text_en: So that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had the craving.
text_cn: 故此人给那地方起名叫克贝洛特阿塔瓦，因为在那里埋葬了贪饕（tāo）的人民。

text_en: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people journeyed to Hazeroth.
text_cn: 以后民众由克贝洛特阿塔瓦起程，向哈兹洛特出发，在哈兹洛特住下了。
